latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Cloudflare MCP skill.

- Supports Cloudflare API access via Code Mode MCP, covering 2500+ endpoints (Workers, DNS, R2, D1, KV, Vectorize, etc.)
- Provides natural language triggers for easy access to common Cloudflare resources and operations.
- Requires MCP server configuration and OAuth authorization on first use.
- Exposes typical Cloudflare actions: list Workers, manage DNS records, create KV namespaces, set up R2 buckets, and view account info.
- All actions are performed through MCP’s search() and execute() tools.
